title: Star X
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes): score 330 -> 350 and lives 2 matched the HUD (the score is followed by its own text copy "0000350")

widgets.text:
Shields, lives, weapons
3D rail shooter in the style of Star Fox: shields drop when hit, ship is lost at zero
Lives and score shown in the HUD

Weapons upgrade with pickups
Weapon pickups upgrade your main gun; secondary weapons have limited ammo
Roll or dodge to avoid incoming fire (the ship moves in a corridor on screen)

Stage-end bosses
Bosses have weak points that flash when hit: aim for those
Clear small fighters early so they don't crowd the screen during the boss

3D shooter stages in space
Stages in space and over planets, played in order, each with a boss

Weapon pickups
Shield refills and weapon power-ups drop from destroyed enemies

Bonuses
Score bonuses for kill streaks and finishing stages with high shields

Stages
Stage count to the final boss; a high-score table keeps your best run
